title: Kissed Yeasty German Prawns Dumplings
description: A yeasty and pillowy German dish featuring raw tiger prawns, perfect for a midnight craving, with a plant-based friendly twist.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and yeast, then gradually add warm water to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Let the dough rest in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Meanwhile, prepare the filling by mixing the chopped onion, minced garlic, and melted plant-based butter in a bowl.
Add the katsuramuki-cut prawns to the bowl and mix gently until they are well coated with the onion mixture.
Once the dough has risen, punch it down and divide it into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, then place a few pieces of the prawn mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Cook the dumplings in a large pot of boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
